source_doc: Market Intelligence for YALai Unlocking Opportunities in AI Cybersecurity.docx
content: For these MSSPs, YAL.ai is not just a product to be resold but a tool to be integrated into their core service offering. By incorporating YAL.ai's AI-driven detection engine into their managed email security service, they can offer a superior level of protection to their clients, creating a powerful differentiator for themselves. This model is highly attractive as it leverages the MSSP's existing customer relationships, billing infrastructure, and support teams, providing YAL.ai with immediate market access and credibility. The second tier of the channel consists of Value-Added Resellers (VARs) and Systems Integrators (SIs) like Dimension Data (part of NTT) and Datacentrix. These partners typically focus on project-based work, designing and implementing end-to-end solutions for large enterprises.
